Features

One workspace for database work.

01

Connect your way

MySQL and MariaDB over TCP, SSL/TLS or SSH tunnels. Import Navicat .ncx and connections.json files.

Read the guide →
02

A capable SQL editor

Multiple tabs, table/column suggestions, formatting, EXPLAIN and multiple result sets. Confirm potentially destructive operations.

Read the guide →
03

Workspaces by project

Group connections by project or environment. Tabs retain context so you can continue working.

Read the guide →
04

End-to-end encrypted sync

Connections and workspaces in an AES-256-GCM vault. Sign-in is optional; database contents are not synced.

Read the guide →
05

Backup and restore

Back up tables, views, triggers, procedures, functions and events. Restore SQL with DELIMITER support.

Read the guide →
06

Streaming import/export

CSV, TSV and JSON with previews and column mapping. Follow progress and cancel tasks from the interface.

Read the guide →

Sync on your terms

Your connections travel. Your keys stay on-device.

The server receives an auth proof and an encrypted vault. Account keys are derived locally with scrypt. Self-host the server or work offline without signing in.

Understand synchronization →

What gets synced

  • ✓ Connections and workspaces in an AES-256-GCM vault.
  • ✓ Database contents and SSH/SSL files are not synced.
  • ✓ Signing out keeps your local data.

Password recovery is not available. A forgotten password cannot decrypt the server vault; read the limitations before enabling sync.

Self-host

Configure your own sync server.

Choose localhost for a local trial, or HTTPS with Caddy for multiple devices. Configuration is generated in your browser.

Deployment settings

Public HTTPS uses ports 80/443; this is the internal app port.

If disabled, you need an existing account or must enable it temporarily.

Enable JavaScript to use the generator, or follow the self-hosting guide.

Start and check

Terminal
docker compose up -d

Save the files in one directory, run the command and open the URL above. Append /healthz to check the server. Inspect status with docker compose ps and logs with docker compose logs --tail=100. Retain the sqlpro-data volume when upgrading.

FAQ

Start with clear expectations.

Find step-by-step instructions and solutions for common error codes in the guides.

Troubleshooting and support →
Do I need an account?

No. Database connections, the SQL editor, backups and import/export work offline. An account is only needed for sync.

Does it support PostgreSQL or SQL Server?

Currently MySQL and MariaDB are supported. Other connection types are skipped during Navicat import.

What if I forget my sync password?

Password recovery and recovery keys are not available. Without the password, the server vault cannot be decrypted; local data remains on your device.

Are SSH private keys synced?

Only paths are synced. Private-key and certificate files must exist on each device at the configured paths.

Which installer should I choose?

Windows: installer .exe or Portable. Ubuntu: .deb; AppImage is an alternative when supported by your environment. Desktop installers currently target x64.
